تعايشت (form VI)
# تَعَايَشْتُ (taʕāyaštu) /ta.ʕaː.jaʃ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
# تَعَايَشْتَ (taʕāyašta) /ta.ʕaː.jaʃ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
# تَعَايَشْتِ (taʕāyašti) /ta.ʕaː.jaʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
# تَعَايَشَتْ (taʕāyašat) /ta.ʕaː.ja.ʃat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
